# Nuxt I18n Micro

> Fast, simple, and lightweight internationalization for Nuxt.js with strategy-based routing and minimal bundle impact.

Optimize your Nuxt app with a powerful and efficient i18n solution.

## Table of Contents

### Integrations

- [Integrations](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/integrations.md): Vue, React, Preact, Solid, Astro, and Node packages.
- [Vue Package (`@i18n-micro/vue`)](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/integrations/vue-package.md): i18n for Vue 3 with @i18n-micro/vue.
- [React Package (`@i18n-micro/react`)](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/integrations/react-package.md): i18n for React with @i18n-micro/react.
- [Preact Package (`@i18n-micro/preact`)](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/integrations/preact-package.md): i18n for Preact with @i18n-micro/preact.
- [Solid Package (`@i18n-micro/solid`)](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/integrations/solid-package.md): i18n for SolidJS with @i18n-micro/solid.
- [Astro Package (`@i18n-micro/astro`)](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/integrations/astro-package.md): i18n for Astro with @i18n-micro/astro.
- [VitePress Package (`@i18n-micro/vitepress`)](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/integrations/vitepress-package.md): Runtime i18n for VitePress themes and markdown pages.
- [Node.js Runtime](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/integrations/nodejs-package.md): i18n for Node.js with @i18n-micro/node.
- [Types Generator (`@i18n-micro/types-generator`)](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/integrations/types-generator.md): Generate TypeScript types from locale JSON.
- [DevTools UI Package (`@i18n-micro/devtools-ui`)](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/integrations/devtools-ui-package.md): Standalone DevTools UI and Vite plugin.

### Guide

- [Getting Started with Nuxt I18n Micro](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/guide/getting-started.md): Install and configure Nuxt I18n Micro.
- [Configuration Reference](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/guide/configuration.md): All nuxt-i18n-micro module options, defaults, and examples.
- [Folder Structure Guide](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/guide/folder-structure.md): Recommended locales folder layout.
- [Routing Strategies in Nuxt I18n Micro](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/guide/strategy.md): URL prefix strategies for locale routing.

### API

- [API Reference](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api.md): Runtime methods, events, translation cache, and server middleware.
- [Methods](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/methods.md): All nuxt-i18n-micro runtime methods.
- [Events](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/events.md): Register translations at runtime with the i18n:register event.
- [Translation Cache & Storage Architecture](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/i18n-cache-api.md): Translation cache layers and payload modes in v3.
- [Module Options Reference](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/module-options.md): Every option the module accepts, with its type, default and purpose — read at build time from the type definition.
- [Package APIs](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/api/packages.md): The exported API of every workspace package, read at build time from the snapshots CI checks against the source.

### Components

- [Components](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/components.md): i18n-t, i18n-link, i18n-switcher, and i18n-group components.
- [`<i18n-t>` Component](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/components/i18n-t.md): Translation component with slot-based interpolation.
- [`<i18n-switcher>` Component](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/components/i18n-switcher.md): Dropdown component for switching app locales.
- [`<i18n-link>` Component](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/components/i18n-link.md): Locale-aware NuxtLink wrapper for localized routes.
- [`<i18n-group>` Component](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/components/i18n-group.md): Group translations under a shared key prefix.

### Composables

- [Composables](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/composables.md): useI18n, useLocaleHead, useI18nHead, and useI18nLocale composables.
- [`useI18n` Composable](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/composables/useI18n.md): Access i18n features in components and scripts.
- [`useLocaleHead` Composable](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/composables/useLocaleHead.md): SEO meta tags and head attrs for localized routes.
- [`useI18nHead` Composable](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/composables/useI18nHead.md): Page-level overrides for i18n SEO meta and link tags.
- [useI18nLocale](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/composables/useI18nLocale.md): Centralized locale state, cookies, and sync.

### News

- [News & Releases](https://s00d.github.io/nuxt-i18n-micro/news.md): Release notes and project updates.
